sync.retryFailed: Session synchronization could not be restarted.

actions.deleteConfirmBody: Recording, evidence, notes, bookmarks, timeline, and cloud copies will be removed.
actions.deleteFailed: The session could not be deleted. Please try again.
actions.cleanupPendingBody: The session is hidden from this device. Cloud files will be removed automatically when the connection is available.

recording.title: Recording
recording.empty: No recording file is available for this session yet.
recording.playbackUnavailable: Playback is temporarily unavailable. Reopen the session to request a new secure link.

transcription.waitForUpload: You can queue transcription now. It will be submitted after the recording is stored securely in the cloud.
transcription.requestFailed: The transcription request could not be saved.

progress.waiting: Waiting for transcription processing to begin.
progress.processingHint: This can take a little while.
progress.retryingResult: The transcript result could not be refreshed yet. Retrying automatically.
progress.retryingRequest: The transcription request is waiting to retry automatically.
progress.ready: The transcript is available on this device.

transcription.retryUploadFirst: Retry the recording upload before requesting transcription.

evidence.openUnavailable: This file cannot be opened on this device.
evidence.previewUnavailable: A secure preview is temporarily unavailable. Reopen the session to request a new link.
evidence.offlineUnavailable: This file is not available on this device yet. Connect to the internet and try again.
evidence.viewerUnavailable: No compatible application is installed to open this file.
evidence.openFailed: This file could not be opened. Please try again.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.empty: No transcript is available on this device yet.
transcript.emptyHint: When transcription finishes, the result will appear here and remain available offline.
transcript.emptyContent: The transcript has no readable text.
transcript.noTimestampedSegments: No timestamped segments are available for this transcript.
transcript.loadFailed: The local transcript could not be opened.
transcript.editedMetadata: Full text version %{version} • Provider version %{sourceVersion} • Evidence segments %{count}
transcript.evidenceProvenance: Timestamps belong to provider transcription version %{sourceVersion}. They are not remapped to the edited full text.
transcript.evidenceUnavailable: Timestamp evidence cannot be verified on this device yet. The full text remains available.
transcript.evidenceNone: No provider timestamp evidence is linked to this edited version.

editor.title: Edit full text
editor.draftHint: Typing saves a draft on this device. Save changes queues an immutable edit for synchronization. Timestamps are not edited.
editor.unavailable: No editable transcript or recoverable draft is available on this device yet.
editor.currentHint: Latest transcript available on this device. Requesting a refresh does not guarantee an immediate server response.
editor.currentUnavailable: The current transcript is not available on this device.
editor.discardBody: Discard this draft and start from the current transcript available on this device. This does not delete transcript history or cancel an outbound Save.
editor.staleBase: This draft uses an earlier base version. Your text is preserved, but a new Save is blocked. This can also happen after your previous Save succeeds. Review the current transcript; no automatic merge or rebase is performed.
editor.serverConflict: The server rejected this Save because its base version changed. Your draft is still here. Review the current transcript before deciding whether to discard the draft.
editor.localConflict: The stored draft changed outside this editor. This open text has not replaced it. Automatic saving is paused to protect both versions.
editor.frozenSame: The previous local Save has not been confirmed. Retry uses its original identifier and exact text.
editor.frozenDifferent: Retry sends the PREVIOUS Save text, not the newer text shown here. Your newer typing remains a separate draft.
editor.closeFailedBody: Stay here and try saving again, or leave this open buffer. Leaving can lose the latest typing. Any draft already stored on this device and any outbound Save remain unchanged.
editor.leavePendingBody: The previous local Save action is unresolved. Closing attempts to preserve your latest draft, but does not retry that action or cancel any outbound Save.
editor.leaveConflictBody: The open text differs from the stored draft. Closing may discard this open buffer; the stored draft is not overwritten. Stay here to keep reviewing it.

local.dirty: Latest typing is not saved on this device yet.
local.storage_error: Latest draft storage could not be confirmed.

sync.none: No outbound Save selected. Draft storage is separate from synchronization.
sync.queued: Changes stored on this device, waiting to synchronize.
sync.submitting: Save is submitting or waiting to resume after an interruption.
sync.retry_wait: Save is waiting for another permitted synchronization attempt.
sync.auth_required: Save is retained. Sign in again to resume synchronization.
sync.feature_disabled: Save is retained. Transcript editing is temporarily unavailable on the server.
sync.conflict: Save has a server version conflict.
sync.outcome_unconfirmed: The previous Save outcome is unconfirmed. Automatic attempts have stopped; do not replace or discard that operation.
sync.cancelled: This Save was cancelled because the session was unavailable.
sync.accepted_refresh_pending: Save accepted by the server. The current transcript cache is awaiting refresh.
sync.accepted_current: Save accepted; this version is current in the local cache.
sync.accepted_other_current: Save accepted; another version is current in the local cache.

errors.autosave: Automatic draft saving could not be scheduled. Try saving the draft again.
errors.inUse: Another editor still owns this session. Close it or wait for its pending local work, then try opening again.
errors.notReady: The local transcript has not finished loading.
errors.busy: Wait for the current editor action to finish.
errors.recovery: Draft continuity could not be verified. The open text has not overwritten stored data.
errors.nativeOnly: Transcript editing is available only in the mobile app.
errors.inactive: This editor is no longer active.
errors.auth: Sign in to the same account before continuing.
errors.deletion: Editing is stopped while account deletion is pending.
errors.invalid: The text or editing context is invalid. Nothing was silently replaced.
errors.tooLarge: The text exceeds the 8 MiB UTF-8 limit. It was not truncated.
errors.blank: A saved edit cannot be blank. An empty local draft is allowed.
errors.unchanged: This text has not changed from its base version.
errors.storage: Local storage could not be confirmed. Keep this editor open and try again.
errors.session: This session is no longer available for editing.
errors.cache: Local editing data could not be validated. Stored data was not overwritten.
errors.current: The current transcript is not available on this device.
errors.base: The draft base version is not available on this device.
errors.baseChanged: The draft base differs from the current transcript. Your text has not been rebased.
errors.draftChanged: The stored draft or confirmation revision changed. No newer draft was overwritten.
errors.pending: An earlier Save is still pending. Its snapshot cannot be replaced.
errors.unconfirmed: An earlier Save outcome must be resolved before another Save or discard.
errors.refresh: Refresh the current transcript before starting another saved edit.
errors.identity: The previous Save identifier does not match this snapshot. No replacement operation was created.
errors.unknown: This editor action could not be completed. Your stored data was not intentionally changed.
